name: Guardian Standard of Recovery's healing buff reaches its own owner (#4968)
contract: Owner-recipient control for #4968, which reports cross-faction party interactions. The Standard of Recovery banner (creature 50053) sets its faction to the owner's faction before casting its aura (500266, an APPLY_AREA_AURA_FRIEND), so the owner should receive the healing-received buff from their own Standard. This control does not exercise opposite-faction party members; guardian-standards-cross-faction-recovery-4968 covers that condition.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
The owner receives their own Standard's healing-received buff
